feature_descriptions.total_pips: Expected production numerator: cards per roll = pips / 36, ignoring robber and bank shortage.
feature_descriptions.wood_pips: Candidate settlement production pips for wood.
feature_descriptions.brick_pips: Candidate settlement production pips for brick.
feature_descriptions.sheep_pips: Candidate settlement production pips for sheep.
feature_descriptions.wheat_pips: Candidate settlement production pips for wheat.
feature_descriptions.ore_pips: Candidate settlement production pips for ore.
feature_descriptions.adjacent_hexes: Number of touching hexes, including desert; coastal/interior control.
feature_descriptions.local_resource_count: Distinct producing resources touched by this candidate.
feature_descriptions.new_resource_types: Resources added that existing own settlements do not produce.
feature_descriptions.new_resource_pips: Candidate pips in resources missing from existing own settlements.
feature_descriptions.combined_resource_count: Distinct resources after adding this candidate to existing own settlements.
feature_descriptions.all_five_covered: One if the combined own portfolio produces all five resources.
feature_descriptions.combined_total_pips: Sum of candidate and existing own settlement pips, counting each settlement.
feature_descriptions.combined_concentration_hhi: Sum of squared resource shares; 1 means one-resource concentration, 0.2 means five equal shares.
feature_descriptions.combined_resource_entropy: Natural-log entropy of combined resource pip shares; zero when concentrated in one resource.
feature_descriptions.combined_wood_pips: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for wood.
feature_descriptions.wood_starting_cards: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_descriptions.combined_brick_pips: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for brick.
feature_descriptions.brick_starting_cards: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_descriptions.combined_sheep_pips: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for sheep.
feature_descriptions.sheep_starting_cards: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_descriptions.combined_wheat_pips: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for wheat.
feature_descriptions.wheat_starting_cards: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_descriptions.combined_ore_pips: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for ore.
feature_descriptions.ore_starting_cards: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_descriptions.direct_port: One if the candidate touches any port.
feature_descriptions.generic_port: One if the candidate touches a generic 3:1 port.
feature_descriptions.wood_port: One if the candidate touches the wood 2:1 port.
feature_descriptions.brick_port: One if the candidate touches the brick 2:1 port.
feature_descriptions.sheep_port: One if the candidate touches the sheep 2:1 port.
feature_descriptions.wheat_port: One if the candidate touches the wheat 2:1 port.
feature_descriptions.ore_port: One if the candidate touches the ore 2:1 port.
feature_descriptions.port_matching_combined_pips: Combined own pips in the specialized port resource, zero unless this candidate directly touches that port.
feature_descriptions.nearest_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance from this candidate to any port corner; ignores ownership, road direction, cost and blocking.
feature_descriptions.nearest_generic_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to any generic 3:1 port corner.
feature_descriptions.wood_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wood port.
feature_descriptions.brick_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to the brick port.
feature_descriptions.sheep_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to the sheep port.
feature_descriptions.wheat_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wheat port.
feature_descriptions.ore_port_distance: Shortest geometric edge distance to the ore port.
feature_descriptions.matched_port_potential: Maximum over resources of combined resource pips / (1 + geometric port distance); already owned ports use distance zero. A descriptive interaction, not a trade-value model.
feature_descriptions.unique_local_numbers: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards at this candidate.
feature_descriptions.unique_combined_numbers: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards for the combined own portfolio.
feature_descriptions.pips_overlapping_owned_numbers: Candidate pips on number outcomes already collected by an own settlement.
feature_descriptions.combined_production_variance: Variance in total cards per roll, counting shared numbers exactly; ignores robber and bank shortage.
feature_descriptions.combined_zero_production_probability: Probability of collecting zero cards on a dice roll, including seven; ignores robber and bank shortage.
feature_descriptions.best_expansion_pips_two_roads: Highest-pip currently distance-rule-open corner exactly two geometric edges away; excludes cost, direction and competition.
feature_descriptions.opponent_proximity: 1/(1 + closest opponent settlement edge distance); zero if no opponent settlement yet.
feature_descriptions.own_proximity: 1/(1 + closest own settlement edge distance); zero if no own settlement yet.
feature_descriptions.desert_adjacency: One if this candidate touches the desert.

precision.candidate_features: float32, rounded from existing float64 descriptive calculations
precision.candidate_logit: float32 neural output; batching can change final floating-point bits
precision.decision_guard: Rows whose best-two batched legal logits are less than 0.001 apart are recomputed individually, and the entire individual logit row is retained.

array_schema.board_resources: [N,19] uint8; wood0 brick1 sheep2 wheat3 ore4 desert5
array_schema.board_ports: [N,9] uint8; resources0..4, generic5; geometry port order
array_schema.history: [N,8] uint8 setup action IDs; settlement72+vertex and road0..71 alternating A1/B1/B2/A2; all steps have referee kind1
array_schema.position_ptr: [4*N+1] int64; board i, stage s uses candidate rows ptr[4*i+s]:ptr[4*i+s+1]
array_schema.candidate_features: [C,50] float32, raw units indexed by feature_names

interpretation: One deterministic greedy opening trajectory per generated board. Scores describe the frozen raw policy, not searched play, causal resource importance or winning probabilities.
resume: Completed shards and their hashes are immutable. A shard left after a crash before manifest publication is validated and adopted on resume.
regenerate: Board arrays plus eight actions reproduce all observations/codes; detailed neuron traces can be regenerated only for selected examples.
